concerns.text: The implementation plan (plan.md) defines a Phase 0 for data acquisition and checksum verification, but the tasks document has no task covering this phase. A task (e.g., T000) should be added to download and verify the raw datasets before preprocessing.

Task T001 is tagged with `[FR-001]` even though its purpose is to download datasets. FR‑001 concerns the implementation of the sparsity knob, not data download. The tag is misleading and should be removed or replaced with the appropriate requirement (e.g., none or a data‑handling requirement).
